test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A runner runs 300 metres race in 36 seconds. The runner’s speed in km/h is:
solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 300 metres

Time = 36 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Speed (km/h) = (Distance (m) / Time (s)) × (18 / 5)

**Calculation:**

Speed (km/h) = (300 / 36) × (18 / 5)

⇒ Speed (km/h) = (300 / 36) × 3.6

⇒ Speed (km/h) = 8.33 × 3.6

⇒ Speed (km/h) = 30

**The runner's speed is 30 km/h.**
